user.title: Connect to your UniFi controller
user.description: Use a local UniFi account (not a ui.com account with 2FA). A read-only 'View Only' admin is enough.

data.host: Host (IP or hostname of the console/controller)
data.port: Port (443 for UDM/UDR/UCG/Cloud Key, 8443 for self-hosted controllers)

abort.already_configured: This controller and site are already configured.
